narrative: 最近十年某地区的移民数量增加了，同时本地失业率也在上升。
question: 所以移民多了会导致本地人失业吗？

must_not_infer.reason: Temporal co-occurrence over the last decade is not evidence of causation — plausible common causes include economic cycle, policy changes, industry composition shifts. A naive extractor should refuse the direct edge.

ambiguities.description: The NL describes two time-correlated trends and invites a causal reading. Standard §3a pattern — likely common causes (economic cycle, policy) make direct cause edge unsafe.
ambiguities.expected_behavior: refuse direct edge; emit confounder structure (e.g., economic_conditions as U → both)

ambiguities.description: '所以...会导致...吗' could read as cause (is there a causal link) or effect (quantify the impact). Conservative pick: cause.
ambiguities.expected_behavior: declare intent ambiguity per §5; pick cause as default
